entries.en: The illustrator used matching colours for the antimeric parts of the body.
entries.zh: 插画师用相同的颜色标出了身体的对称部分。

entries.en: A blue arrow marked the antimesenteric border in the anatomical sketch.
entries.zh: 解剖素描中，一支蓝色箭头标出了肠系膜对侧的边缘。

entries.meaningZh: 屈光参差〔一眼近视、一眼远视〕
entries.en: The diagram of antimetropia showed a short-sighted eye beside a long-sighted one.
entries.zh: 那张屈光参差示意图将一只近视眼与一只远视眼并列画出。

entries.en: Her essay examined the antimiasmatic measures proposed before the old marsh was drained.
entries.zh: 她的文章研究了那片旧沼泽排水之前提出的抗瘴毒措施。

entries.en: The technician checked the antimonate sample number against the laboratory register.
entries.zh: 技术人员对照实验室登记簿核查了锑酸盐样品的编号。

entries.en: The exhibition traced the changing use of antimonials through old hospital records.
entries.zh: 展览借助旧医院记录，梳理了锑剂用途的变化。

entries.en: The antimoniate specimen remained sealed while the curator photographed its handwritten label.
entries.zh: 馆员拍摄手写标签时，那份锑酸盐标本始终保持密封。

entries.en: Their discussion concerned an antimonide crystal rather than a sample of pure antimony.
entries.zh: 他们讨论的是一块锑化物晶体，而不是一份纯锑样品。

entries.en: The narrow antimonite specimen fitted neatly into the collector's padded tray.
entries.zh: 那件细长的辉锑矿标本正好放进收藏者带衬垫的托盘。

entries.en: The old pharmacy inventory listed antimonium separately from the compounds containing it.
entries.zh: 那份旧药房清单将锑与含锑化合物分别列出。

entries.en: The old sketch identified an antimonous compound but omitted its formula.
entries.zh: 那幅旧草图标明了一种含三价锑的化合物，却没有列出其化学式。

entries.en: She circled the antimonyl group in the diagram before discussing the rest of the structure.
entries.zh: 她先在图中圈出锑酰基，再讨论结构的其余部分。

entries.en: The historian questioned the antimorbific claims in the nineteenth-century advertisement.
entries.zh: 史学研究者质疑了那则十九世纪广告中的防病宣称。

entries.en: The review compared antimyasthenic studies that measured changes in muscle strength.
entries.zh: 那篇综述比较了测量肌力变化的抗肌无力研究。

entries.en: The researchers reported antimycobacterial activity without claiming that the compound was ready for clinical use.
entries.zh: 研究人员报告了抗分枝杆菌活性，但没有宣称该化合物已可用于临床。

entries.en: The old paper discussed an antimydriatic effect but left several observations unexplained.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论文讨论了治散瞳作用，却没有解释几项观察结果。

entries.meaningZh: 抗肿瘤物质〔实验性名称，疗效未确证〕
entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the antineoplaston claims had been independently tested.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，有关这种抗肿瘤物质的宣称是否经过独立检验。

entries.meaningZh: 抗肿瘤物质〔实验性名称，疗效未确证〕
entries.en: Her review questioned whether the reports on antineoplastons separated speculation from clinical evidence.
entries.zh: 她的综述质疑，有关这些抗肿瘤物质的报告是否区分了推测与临床证据。

entries.en: The editor requested stronger evidence for the proposed antinephritic action.
entries.zh: 编辑要求为所提出的抗肾炎作用提供更有力的证据。

entries.meaningZh: 安提讷文；水杨溴乙酰苯胺〔旧名称〕
entries.en: The catalogue photograph showed an antinervin container beside its original cardboard packaging.
entries.zh: 目录照片中，安提讷文容器放在原来的纸板包装旁。

entries.en: The lecture distinguished antineuritic effects from temporary relief of pain.
entries.zh: 讲座区分了抗神经炎作用与暂时缓解疼痛。

entries.meaningZh: 反神经元论的解剖学家〔历史用语〕
entries.en: The antineuronist disputed the drawing's division of the nerve network into separate cells.
entries.zh: 那位反神经元论的解剖学家反对该图将神经网络划分成彼此独立的细胞。

entries.meaningZh: 治疗神经疾病的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historical advertisement made antineuropathic claims but supplied no case records.
entries.zh: 那则历史广告提出了治疗神经疾病的宣称，却没有提供病例记录。

entries.en: The report compared antineurotoxin samples from two independently numbered collections.
entries.zh: 那份报告比较了来自两个独立编号的样品系列的抗神经毒素样品。

entries.en: The researcher distinguished antiniacin from niacin in the discussion of vitamin antagonists.
entries.zh: 研究人员在讨论维生素拮抗物时，区分了抗烟酸与烟酸。

entries.meaningZh: 对枕尖的〔旧解剖学用语〕
entries.en: The antinial region was highlighted in the enlarged drawing of the skull.
entries.zh: 放大的颅骨图突出标出了对枕尖区域。

entries.meaningZh: 安提诺辛；碘酞钠〔旧名称〕
entries.en: The old pharmacy order listed antinosin separately from iodoform.
entries.zh: 那份旧药房订单将安提诺辛与碘仿分别列出。

entries.meaningZh: 安条克〔希腊神话中赫拉克勒斯与梅达之子〕
entries.en: The lecturer placed Antiochus beneath Heracles and Meda on the mythological family tree.
entries.zh: 讲者在神话人物谱系图中，将安条克列在赫拉克勒斯与梅达的下一代。

entries.en: The old dental catalogue advertised an antiodontalgic preparation beside several surgical instruments.
entries.zh: 那本旧牙科目录在几件外科器械旁刊登了一种止牙痛制剂的广告。

entries.en: The damaged pamphlet described antiophthalmic remedies without identifying their ingredients.
entries.zh: 那本受损的小册子描述了抗眼炎药物，却没有说明其成分。

entries.en: The researcher added a separate note about antiopsonin to the discussion of phagocytosis.
entries.zh: 研究人员在讨论吞噬作用的部分另加了一条关于抗调理素的说明。

entries.en: Her review treated antiorgan antibodies separately from antibodies directed against circulating proteins.
entries.zh: 她的综述将抗器官抗体与针对循环蛋白的抗体分别讨论。

entries.en: The essay questioned the antiorgastic properties attributed to the old remedy.
entries.zh: 那篇文章质疑了旧药物被认为具有的制欲作用。

entries.en: The laboratory compared antiovalbumin from the two archived serum collections.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了两套存档血清中的抗卵清蛋白。

entries.en: The old rubber handbook discussed an antioxygen but did not disclose its composition.
entries.zh: 那本旧橡胶手册讨论了一种抗氧化剂，却没有公开其组成。

entries.en: The seminar compared antioxygenation in the two materials under discussion.
entries.zh: 研讨会比较了正在讨论的两种材料中的抗氧化作用。

entries.en: The archive held several early reports on antipaludian campaigns in the coastal settlements.
entries.zh: 档案馆保存着几份关于沿海聚落早期抗疟行动的报告。

entries.en: The historian examined the evidence behind the advertisement's antiparalytic claims.
entries.zh: 史学研究者考察了那则广告中抗麻痹宣称的依据。

entries.meaningZh: 安提帕拉西丁；二硝基煤酚钾〔旧名称〕
entries.en: The handwritten inventory identified the antiparasitin sample, but gave no date of acquisition.
entries.zh: 手写清单标明了那份安提帕拉西丁样品，却没有注明取得日期。

entries.meaningZh: 尿道球腺〔旧解剖学名称〕
entries.en: The illustration of the antiparastata appeared beside a drawing of the urethra.
entries.zh: 尿道球腺的插图放在一幅尿道图旁。

entries.meaningZh: 尿道球腺炎〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The casebook's account of antiparastatitis referred to notes that had not survived.
entries.zh: 病例集对尿道球腺炎的记述提到了未能保存下来的笔记。

entries.en: He was antipathic to the proposal, though he listened politely to its supporters.
entries.zh: 他对这项提议怀有反感，却仍礼貌地听取支持者的意见。

entries.en: The review questioned whether the experimental antipathogen acted against more than one species.
entries.zh: 那篇综述质疑，这种实验性抗病原药是否能对不止一个物种起作用。

entries.en: The exhibition included an old antipedicular comb with a broken wooden handle.
entries.zh: 展览中有一把木柄折断的旧灭虱梳。

entries.en: The discussion of antipepsin focused on inhibition rather than the amount of pepsin present.
entries.zh: 关于抗胃蛋白酶的讨论侧重于抑制作用，而不是胃蛋白酶的含量。

entries.en: The historian compared the descriptions of antipeptone in two early digestion studies.
entries.zh: 史学研究者比较了两项早期消化研究对抗胨的描述。

entries.en: The analyst checked the antiperiodic boundary condition before comparing the two solutions.
entries.zh: 分析人员在比较两个解之前，核查了反周期边界条件。

entries.en: The animation showed an antiperistaltic wave moving opposite to the usual direction.
entries.zh: 动画显示一股逆蠕动波朝通常方向的反向移动。

entries.en: The botanist marked the antipetalous stamens in blue on the flower diagram.
entries.zh: 植物学家在花的示意图中，用蓝色标出了与花瓣相对的雄蕊。

entries.meaningZh: 抗吞噬素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared early accounts of antiphagin with later discussions of bacterial resistance to phagocytosis.
entries.zh: 史学研究者将早期的抗吞噬素记述与后来关于细菌抗吞噬作用的讨论作了比较。

entries.en: The researchers questioned whether the observed effect was genuinely antiphagocytic.
entries.zh: 研究人员质疑所观察到的作用是否确实具有抗吞噬性。

entries.en: The old advertisement promised antiphialtic benefits without providing evidence about sleep.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告承诺有抗梦魇的益处，却没有提供有关睡眠的证据。

entries.meaningZh: 抗蟾蜍溶血素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The archive's report on antiphrynolysin lacked the photographs mentioned in its final paragraph.
entries.zh: 档案馆那份关于抗蟾蜍溶血素的报告，缺少末段提到的照片。

entries.en: The museum displayed an antiphthiriac preparation beside an early lice comb.
entries.zh: 博物馆在一把早期虱梳旁陈列了一种灭虱制剂。

entries.en: Her essay examined antiphthisic claims in advertisements from the old sanatorium.
entries.zh: 她的文章考察了那家旧疗养院广告中的抗结核宣称。

entries.en: The lecturer separated the discussion of antiphytotoxin from the section on bacterial toxins.
entries.zh: 讲者将抗植物性毒素的讨论与细菌毒素部分分开。

entries.en: The city archive lent us posters from an early antiplague campaign.
entries.zh: 市档案馆借给我们一场早期抗鼠疫行动的海报。

entries.en: The report listed antiplasmin separately from the other inhibitors under discussion.
entries.zh: 那份报告将抗纤维蛋白溶酶与正在讨论的其他抑制物分别列出。

entries.en: The review distinguished antiplasmodial activity in the laboratory from demonstrated clinical benefit.
entries.zh: 那篇综述区分了实验室中的抗疟原虫活性与已经证实的临床获益。

entries.meaningZh: 妨碍愈合的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the antiplastic effect attributed to the old preparation.
entries.zh: 史学研究者质疑了旧制剂被认为具有的妨碍愈合作用。

entries.en: The form had a separate box for recording antiplatelet medication.
entries.zh: 那张表格有一栏专门记录抗血小板药物。

entries.en: Several early papers on antipneumococcic serum were bound together in the archive volume.
entries.zh: 几篇关于抗肺炎球菌血清的早期论文被合订在那册档案中。

entries.meaningZh: 抗肺炎毒素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The historian compared the account of antipneumotoxin with the author's later work on pneumococci.
entries.zh: 史学研究者将抗肺炎毒素的记述与该作者后来关于肺炎球菌的研究作了比较。

entries.en: The pharmacist's old notebook distinguished antipodagric remedies from ordinary painkillers.
entries.zh: 那本旧药剂师笔记区分了治痛风药物与普通止痛药。

entries.en: The seminar's discussion of antiprecipitin continued after the last slide had been shown.
entries.zh: 最后一张幻灯片放完后，研讨会仍在继续讨论抗沉淀素。

entries.meaningZh: 尿道球腺炎〔旧医学名称〕
entries.en: The old case description of antiprostatitis gave conflicting dates for the first symptoms.
entries.zh: 那份关于尿道球腺炎的旧病例说明，对最初症状出现的日期记载不一致。

entries.en: The analysis compared samples containing antiprotease with untreated control samples.
entries.zh: 分析比较了含抗蛋白酶的样品与未经处理的对照样品。

entries.en: The review placed antiprothrombin antibodies in a separate table from the other antibodies.
entries.zh: 那篇综述将抗凝血酶原抗体与其他抗体分别列在不同的表格中。

entries.en: The proposed antiprotozoan effect still required independent investigation.
entries.zh: 所提出的抗原生动物作用仍需独立研究。

entries.en: The editor asked how the claimed antipruriginous effect had been measured.
entries.zh: 编辑询问，所宣称的止痒作用是如何测量的。

entries.meaningZh: 抑制精神性运动的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The paper questioned the proposed antipsychomotor effect rather than treating it as established.
entries.zh: 那篇论文质疑了所提出的抑制精神性运动作用，而没有将其视为定论。

entries.en: The historical review questioned the antipurpuric claims made for the mixture.
entries.zh: 那篇医学史综述质疑了针对该混合物提出的抗紫癜宣称。

entries.en: The conservator studied the antiputrefactive claims in the old specimen-preservation manual.
entries.zh: 文物修复师研究了那本旧标本保存手册中的防腐宣称。

entries.meaningZh: 防止化脓的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old catalogue grouped antipyic dressings separately from bandages used only for support.
entries.zh: 那本旧目录将防止化脓的敷料与仅用于支撑的绷带分开归类。

entries.en: The report discussed an antipyogenic effect without recommending a treatment regimen.
entries.zh: 那份报告讨论了防止化脓的作用，但没有推荐治疗方案。

entries.en: The curator kept the antipyonin container beside its original pharmacy receipt.
entries.zh: 馆员将安提皮奥宁容器与原来的药房收据放在一起。

entries.en: The archive's antirabic campaign posters had faded along their folded edges.
entries.zh: 档案馆那些防治狂犬病行动海报的折边已经褪色。

entries.en: The lecture compared early antirachitic research with later accounts of nutrition.
entries.zh: 讲座将早期治疗佝偻病的研究与后来的营养学论述作了比较。

entries.en: The researcher discussed antirennet in a section separate from the description of milk samples.
entries.zh: 研究人员将抗凝乳酶的讨论单列一节，与牛奶样品的描述分开。

entries.en: The old study compared antirennin results from two independently labelled serum samples.
entries.zh: 那项旧研究比较了两份独立标记的血清样品的抗凝乳酶结果。

entries.meaningZh: 抗网织的〔旧免疫学用语〕
entries.en: The old lecture compared antireticular serum preparations from two laboratories.
entries.zh: 那次旧讲座比较了来自两个实验室的抗网织血清制剂。

entries.en: She recorded antiretroviral medication in the appropriate section of the form.
entries.zh: 她在表格的相应栏目中记录了抗逆转录病毒药物。

entries.en: The review compared antirheumatic studies without treating every reported improvement as proof of efficacy.
entries.zh: 那篇综述比较了治疗风湿病的研究，但没有将每一项报告的改善都视为疗效证据。

entries.en: The librarian found an early paper on antiricin filed under the wrong author's name.
entries.zh: 图书馆员发现，一篇关于抗蓖麻毒蛋白的早期论文被归在了错误的作者名下。

entries.en: The archive kept the antirobin study with the other plant-antitoxin reports.
entries.zh: 档案馆将那项抗刺槐毒素研究与其他植物抗毒素报告保存在一起。

entries.en: The physiologist discussed antisaluresis alongside the recorded changes in urinary salt output.
entries.zh: 生理学家在讨论尿排盐抑制时，同时提到了所记录的尿盐排出量变化。

entries.en: Clouds hid Antisana before the photographer could finish her sketch of the valley.
entries.zh: 摄影师还没画完山谷素描，云层就遮住了安提萨那山。

entries.en: The museum label described an old antiscabietic preparation without endorsing its use.
entries.zh: 博物馆标签介绍了一种旧抗疥制剂，但并没有认可其使用。

entries.en: The essay examined antiscabious remedies mentioned in the ship's medical log.
entries.zh: 那篇文章研究了船舶医疗日志中提到的抗疥药物。

entries.en: The review distinguished antischistosomal activity from effects on unrelated parasites.
entries.zh: 那篇综述区分了抗血吸虫活性与对其他不相关寄生虫的作用。

entries.en: The old advertisement claimed an antiscolic action but offered no supporting observations.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告声称具有驱虫作用，却没有提供支持这一说法的观察记录。

entries.en: The researchers compared antisecretory responses in the treatment and control groups.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了处理组和对照组的抑制分泌反应。

entries.en: The old immunology paper discussed antisensitizer after introducing the corresponding sensitizer.
entries.zh: 那篇旧免疫学论文先介绍相应的介体，然后讨论抗介体。

entries.meaningZh: 安提塞普辛；对溴乙酰苯胺〔旧名〕
entries.en: The curator found correspondence about antisepsin tucked inside the chemist's notebook.
entries.zh: 馆员在化学家的笔记本中找到了夹着的有关安提塞普辛的通信。

entries.en: Her history of antisepticism drew on hospital correspondence as well as published reports.
entries.zh: 她撰写抗菌法史时，既参考了公开报告，也利用了医院通信。

entries.meaningZh: 安提塞普托；碘硫酸辛可宁〔旧名〕
entries.en: The chemist's correspondence about antiseptol survived, but the accompanying laboratory notebook did not.
entries.zh: 化学家关于安提塞普托的通信保存了下来，随附的实验室笔记本却没有。

entries.en: The review discussed antiserotonin activity separately from effects on other signalling pathways.
entries.zh: 那篇综述将抗血清素活性与对其他信号通路的作用分开讨论。

entries.en: The old formulary listed an antisialogogue in a section distinct from saliva-stimulating preparations.
entries.zh: 那本旧处方集将一种止涎剂列在单独的部分，与促进唾液分泌的制剂分开。

entries.en: The study assessed antisickling activity without presenting the mixture as an approved medicine.
entries.zh: 那项研究评估了抗镰形细胞形成活性，但没有将该混合物说成获批药物。

entries.meaningZh: 与铁不相容的〔旧药学用语〕
entries.en: The chemist questioned whether the mixture was antisideric before interpreting the old experiment.
entries.zh: 化学家在解释那项旧实验之前，质疑该混合物是否与铁不相容。

entries.en: The museum retained the antispasmin package but no longer had the accompanying receipt.
entries.zh: 博物馆保留了镇痉素包装，却已没有随附的收据。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the claimed antispastic effect had been independently reproduced.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，所宣称的镇痉作用是否已被独立重复证实。

entries.en: The essay examined antisplenetic claims in a collection of historical pharmacy advertisements.
entries.zh: 那篇文章考察了一批历史药房广告中的抗脾病宣称。

entries.en: The illustrator enlarged the antisquama in the drawing of the fly's wing.
entries.zh: 插画师在那幅苍蝇翅膀的图中，将上翅瓣放大画出。

entries.en: The diagram used a reversed arrow to distinguish antistalsis from the usual movement.
entries.zh: 那张图用一支反向箭头，将逆蠕动与通常的运动区分开。

entries.en: The archive's earliest antistaphylococcic serum reports were bound in a separate volume.
entries.zh: 档案馆最早的抗葡萄球菌血清报告被合订成了单独的一册。

entries.en: The laboratory record listed antistaphylohemolysin separately from the corresponding hemolysin.
entries.zh: 实验室记录将抗葡萄球菌溶血素与相应的溶血素分别列出。

entries.en: The report compared antistaphylolysin measurements from the two serum collections.
entries.zh: 那份报告比较了两套血清的抗葡萄球菌溶血素测量结果。

entries.en: The historian questioned the conclusions drawn from the early antisterility experiments.
entries.zh: 史学研究者质疑了那些早期抗不育实验所作的结论。

entries.en: A drawing of the antisternum occupied the centre of the old skeletal chart.
entries.zh: 那张旧骨骼图的中央是一幅脊椎绘图。

entries.en: The catalogue showed an Antisterone package beside its original pharmacy receipt.
entries.zh: 目录展示了一个安体舒通包装，旁边是原来的药房收据。

entries.en: The lecture compared early antistreptococcic serum research with later historical assessments.
entries.zh: 讲座将早期抗链球菌血清研究与后来的历史评价作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 抗链球菌毒素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The surviving manuscript discussed antistreptococcin before turning to other bacterial antitoxins.
entries.zh: 保存下来的手稿先讨论抗链球菌毒素，然后转向其他细菌抗毒素。

entries.en: The reviewer requested clearer explanations of the antistreptohemolysin results.
entries.zh: 审稿人要求对抗链球菌溶血素结果作出更清楚的解释。

entries.en: The paper discussed antistreptokinase antibodies without recommending a clinical test.
entries.zh: 那篇论文讨论了抗链球菌激酶抗体，但没有推荐临床检测。

entries.en: The chart displayed antistreptolysin measurements without identifying the individual patients.
entries.zh: 图表展示了抗链球菌溶血素测量结果，但没有标明患者个人身份。

entries.meaningZh: 抗剥离的〔沥青材料用语〕
entries.en: The road laboratory compared two antistripping additives before preparing its materials report.
entries.zh: 道路实验室在编写材料报告之前，比较了两种抗剥离添加剂。

entries.en: The historical catalogue placed antistrumous preparations beside other remedies for glandular disorders.
entries.zh: 那本历史目录将抗瘰疬制剂与其他治疗腺体疾病的药物并列。

entries.en: The old account distinguished an antisubstance from the material that stimulated its production.
entries.zh: 那份旧记述区分了抗体与刺激其产生的物质。

entries.en: The old advertisement promised an antisudoral effect without explaining how it was measured.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告承诺有止汗作用，却没有说明如何测量。

entries.en: The reviewer questioned the evidence for the preparation's antisudorific action.
entries.zh: 审稿人质疑了该制剂止汗作用的证据。

entries.en: The historian found an antitetanic serum record among the hospital's wartime papers.
entries.zh: 史学研究者在医院的战时文献中发现了一份抗破伤风血清记录。

entries.en: The lecture compared the antithermic claims in two old pharmaceutical advertisements.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了两则旧药品广告中的退热宣称。

entries.en: The exhibition included an antithermin container with a badly faded handwritten label.
entries.zh: 展览中有一个戊酮酸苯腙容器，其手写标签已严重褪色。

entries.en: The discussion of antithiamine activity was kept separate from the vitamin's ordinary nutritional role.
entries.zh: 抗硫胺活性的讨论与该维生素通常的营养作用被分开处理。

entries.en: The report discussed antithrombin in the section on proteins involved in blood coagulation.
entries.zh: 那份报告在关于参与凝血过程的蛋白质的部分讨论了抗凝血酶。

entries.en: The review questioned the proposed antithyrotoxic effect because the supporting observations were incomplete.
entries.zh: 那篇综述质疑了所提出的抗甲状腺毒性作用，因为支持这一说法的观察记录并不完整。

entries.en: The researchers discussed antithyrotropic activity without identifying a mechanism in this report.
entries.zh: 研究人员在这份报告中讨论了抗促甲状腺激素活性，但没有确定其机制。

entries.en: The paper discussed antithyroxinogenesis alongside observations of reduced thyroxine production.
entries.zh: 那篇论文在讨论抗甲状腺素生成的同时，提到了甲状腺素生成减少的观察结果。

entries.meaningZh: 降低肌肉或血管张力的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The author distinguished an antitonic effect from a change in emotional tension.
entries.zh: 作者区分了降低肌肉或血管张力的作用与情绪紧张程度的变化。

entries.meaningZh: 抗毒素原〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The old diagram placed antitoxigen before the corresponding antitoxin in its proposed sequence.
entries.zh: 那张旧图在所提出的顺序中，将抗毒素原放在相应抗毒素之前。

entries.meaningZh: 抗毒素原〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The old account distinguished antitoxinogen from the antitoxin produced in response.
entries.zh: 那份旧记述区分了抗毒素原与相应产生的抗毒素。

entries.en: The museum's antitoxinum container was displayed beside the pharmacy's original order book.
entries.zh: 博物馆的抗毒素容器与药房原来的订货簿一同展出。

entries.en: The study discussed antitoxoplasma antibodies detected in the archived serum samples.
entries.zh: 那项研究讨论了在存档血清样品中检出的抗弓形体抗体。

entries.en: The anatomist marked the antitragicus in red on the enlarged ear model.
entries.zh: 解剖学家在放大的耳模型上，用红色标出了对耳屏肌。

entries.en: The antitragohelicine fissure was visible in the enlarged anatomical photograph.
entries.zh: 放大的解剖照片中可以看到对耳屏耳轮裂。

entries.en: A small shadow obscured the antitragus in the first photograph of the ear.
entries.zh: 第一张耳部照片中，一小片阴影遮住了对耳屏。

entries.en: The review separated antitreponemal activity from effects on other bacteria.
entries.zh: 那篇综述将抗密螺旋体活性与对其他细菌的作用分开讨论。

entries.en: The old account of antitrismus reported that the patient could not close his mouth.
entries.zh: 那份关于张口痉挛的旧记述称，患者无法闭口。

entries.en: The engraver placed the two antitropic figures on opposite sides of the central line.
entries.zh: 雕刻师将那对相似对称的图形放在中线的两侧。

entries.en: The authors discussed antitrypanosomal activity without claiming that all parasite species would respond alike.
entries.zh: 作者讨论了抗锥体虫活性，但没有宣称所有寄生虫物种都会有相同反应。

entries.en: The old paper compared antitrypsic activity in the two serum collections.
entries.zh: 那篇旧论文比较了两套血清的抗胰蛋白酶活性。

entries.en: The review discussed antitrypsin alongside other inhibitors of protein breakdown.
entries.zh: 那篇综述将抗胰蛋白酶与其他抑制蛋白质分解的物质一并讨论。

entries.en: The analysis compared antitryptic activity rather than the total amount of protein.
entries.zh: 那项分析比较的是抗胰蛋白酶活性，而不是蛋白质总量。

entries.meaningZh: 抗结核菌素〔旧免疫学名称〕
entries.en: The historian distinguished the old antituberculin study from later tuberculosis reports.
entries.zh: 史学研究者将那项旧抗结核菌素研究与后来的结核病报告作了区分。

entries.en: The review examined antituberculotic activity without proposing a treatment regimen.
entries.zh: 那篇综述考察了抗结核活性，但没有提出治疗方案。
